answers.reasoning: Zustand 5.x vanilla createStore's api is setState/getState/getInitialState/subscribe; destroy was removed and getSnapshot/dispatch aren't zustand core methods.
setState's no-op guard is Object.is(partial, currentState) checked before merging, so a fresh literal object never bails out even with identical content.
Default setState does a shallow Object.assign merge at the top level only, so nested fully replaces to {count:1} (dropping label) while sibling key other:5 is untouched.
replace defaults via replace ?? (typeof nextState !== 'object' || nextState === null); passing null with no replace triggers the nextState===null branch and forces a full replace to null.
initialState is captured once as a const when the creator runs at store construction; getInitialState just returns that same reference and the creator is never invoked again.
